status: Exploratory alternative motivated after pooled relative-efficiency results, before computing repricing payoffs.
assumption: Cumulative conditional expected profit from actual repricing is at least the payoff from retaining the previous fresh daily quote. No optimality among all prices or numerical regret allowance.
primary: Undo all actual changes in one joint comparison. Stronger alternatives separately undo cuts and increases, and impose comparisons per device model.
previous_price: Same listing present at the immediately preceding calendar day, with both snapshots fresh; November 19 is not a fresh previous date. Otherwise no rollback.
payoffs: Include owned-inventory spillovers on every retained listing; entrants and noneligible prices stay fixed. Same corrected five-fold additive fit, no refitting choices.
costs: Nonnegative unrestricted persistent listing opportunity costs; baseline pooled nonnegative contribution, separately label device participation/performance.
qualification: Purposeful repricing is suggestive, not established. Expected profitability refers to researcher-maintained true conditional demand, so private signals or model errors can invalidate it. Splitting by sign or device adds conditional performance restrictions. Cost not known or calibrated.
